answer: Onyx Pulse Gate: before each sonnet epoch, agents commit blinded nonces plus a fresh task hash; a threshold VRF seeded by the prior onyx pulse then draws low-probability admission tickets. Since the seed postdates commitments and proofs bind to live work, attackers cannot precompute lucky IDs. Sybils must run concurrent real agents, complete fresh tasks in the reveal-to-deadline window, and absorb repeated failed admissions—costing parallel compute, bandwidth, and task execution.
